about_the_game:
A cozy crafting simulation where you create magical cats and make the world a better place.

In a gray, joyless city (no surprise - there were NO cats), everything changes when your whimsical van rolls into town. Welcome to Cat Craft - a relaxing first-person sandbox simulation where you run your own Cat Café, grow enchanted ingredients, and brew magical potions to summon Unique Cats for your customers.

Watch as your creations bring life, color, and laughter back into the city - while keeping your Cat Café customers happy and your world ever brighter.

With endless cat combinations (every cat is truly unique), a wholesome story, and chill vibes throughout, Cat Craft is your next cozy obsession.

CRAFT. MORE. CATS

About the Game

CatCraft blends the charm of Stardew Valley, the creativity of Potion Craft, and the heart of Animal Crossing into a joyful single-player experience for cat lovers and cozy sim fans alike.

You’ll:

  • Craft magical cats in your alchemy lab from hundreds of visual + behavioral components.

  • Care for your cats in the Cat House - keep them happy and healthy by improving their living conditions, brushing their fur, feeding them, and bonding with them.

  • Grow your café by matching cats to visitors and transforming the town into a happy place.

  • Tend your garden to cultivate exotic ingredients and rare fruit for advanced cat recipes

  • Travel the world in your van to unlock new seeds, ingredients, quests, and cozy locales

  • Decorate, personalize, and expand every part of your world - from café layout to lab equipment

🎮 Features

🔬 Limitless Cat Crafting


Combine ingredients to generate entirely unique cats with different heads, tails, paws, patterns, behaviors, animations, and more. Every cat is truly one-of-a-kind, not just in your game, but in the world.

🏞️ Enchanting Gameplay Loops

  • Café Loop: Match cats to customer requests, earn reputation, and expand your café.

  • Garden Loop: Plant magical crops to unlock new recipes and mechanics.

  • Lab Loop: Become a master alchemist by experimenting with rare ingredients and gear.

  • Travel Loop: Explore new biomes, unlock van upgrades, and meet quirky NPCs.

🏙️ Happy City Metagame

Each cat you craft for a customer becomes their new companion - and transforms their home from gloom to bloom. Watch as the once-dull city fills with joy, color, and cat magic.

👩‍🌾 For Cozy Gamers & Cat Lovers

Built for chill, creative play. If you love cats, crafting, or games like PotionCraft, Cat Café Manager, and Stardew Valley, CatCraft is made for you.

🐈 Why Wishlist CatCraft?

  • 🐈 To bring an endless supply of truly unique cats into the world

  • ✨ Heartfelt, low-stress gameplay with endless creativity

  • 🎨 Whimsical hand-crafted art style you’ll fall in love with

  • 🧶 Relaxing progression that fits any mood or play session

  • 🚀 Coming Q3 2026 to Steam, Mac, and more

MAKE THE WORLD A BETTER PLACE.


CRAFT. MORE. CATS.

🐾 Add CatCraft to your wishlist and follow us to get updates, sneak peeks, and dev diaries!

short_description: You’ll enter a magical world where you grow gardens, mix potions, and craft endless unique cats for your cozy café. Each cat you create delights visitors and brightens your world. Explore for rare ingredients, bring them home to craft wonders, and fill life with warmth, color, and purrs. Meow!
